selection_policy: Unchecked leaves first, then oldest last_checked_at, then stable relative wiki path; index/reserved/digest/source-workflow/federation/schema pages excluded unless clearly durable security leaves.
upstream_routing: Per docs/wiki/federation.md, broad framework/product/package context routes to ai-wiki and broad development practice routes to ai-dev-wiki.

Local retention is limited to security-specific boundaries: affected versions, authorization, data exposure, tool/network/file access, telemetry redaction, prompt role boundaries, mitigations, and residual risk.
Obot October 6 vMCP product documentation is an upstream product update unless an ingest uses it only to clarify local vMCP authorization/security implications.
